title: NR Polar Decoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/NR_Polar_Decoder.md
text: Perform polar decoding according to 5G NR standard, 5 inputs, 4 outputs; {Link direction} sets the direction of 5G NR, {List length} sets the number of decoding paths, {Configuration source} sets the source for K, {Message length (K)} sets the length of information block in bits, {Rate-matched length (E)} sets the rate-matched output length in bits, {Full checksum mismatch} sets the return checksum from final decoding stage and {Enable target RNTI port} sets the optional port to specify target RNTI value. Values come from the instance.
